svg.title: Which Intune report answers which Cloud PC question
svg.desc: Nine questions an administrator can ask about Cloud PCs, each matched to the report in the Microsoft Intune admin center that answers it: Connection health, User and devices, Configuration monitoring, Connection quality, Cloud PCs that are not available, Connectivity health checks, Resource performance, Cloud PC utilization and Connected Windows 365 Flex Cloud PCs (preview).
svg.text: Failures, sign-in time, round trip time
What happened to one user or Cloud PC?
Errors, sign-in time, round trip time
Monitor Cloud PCs > User and devices
Do problem connections share a setting?
Which Cloud PCs have a weak connection?
Which Cloud PCs were recently unavailable?
Why can one Cloud PC not connect?
Devices > All Cloud PCs > select a Cloud PC >
Is a Cloud PC short of CPU or RAM?
CPU and RAM spike time scores
Who barely uses their Cloud PC?
Are my Flex licenses enough at peak use?
Each arrow matches a question to a report. The arrows are not steps in a sequence.
